::: {.lead}
When we started Marquez Family Home Care, we wanted to understand our neighbors before we
knocked on a single door. Who in our community needs help at home, and what kind of help?
We went to the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey for answers.
:::

We looked at two groups we care for:

- **Seniors (65 and older)** who want to stay safe and comfortable in the home they know.
- **Younger adults (18 to 64) living with a disability**, including people with developmental
  disabilities and people recovering from a brain or spinal cord injury.

The Census doesn't ask whether someone "needs a caregiver." It asks about specific
difficulties, and two of them line up closely with non-medical home care:

| Census question | What it means day to day | How a caregiver helps |
|---|---|---|
| **Self-care difficulty** | Trouble bathing or dressing | Personal care, done with dignity |
| **Independent-living difficulty** | Trouble running errands or getting to appointments alone | Companionship, errands, rides, meals, light housekeeping |


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

# ACS 5-year vintage. 2024 = the 2020–2024 survey. Drop to 2023 if load_variables() errors.
acs_year <- 2024

# Neighborhoods within a reasonable drive of Bonita (ZIP code tabulation areas)
service_area <- tribble(
  ~zcta,   ~area,
  "91902", "Bonita",
  "91910", "Chula Vista (northwest)",
  "91911", "Chula Vista (southwest)",
  "91913", "Chula Vista (Eastlake / Otay Ranch)",
  "91914", "Chula Vista (Eastlake northeast)",
  "91915", "Chula Vista (Eastlake Greens)",
  "91950", "National City",
  "91932", "Imperial Beach",
  "92154", "Otay Mesa / Nestor",
  "92173", "San Ysidro",
  "91977", "Spring Valley",
  "91978", "Spring Valley (east)",
  "91945", "Lemon Grove",
  "91941", "La Mesa / Mount Helix",
  "91942", "La Mesa",
  "92139", "Paradise Hills",
  "92114", "Encanto / Skyline",
  "92113", "Logan Heights"
)
service_zips <- service_area$zcta

if (Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY") == "") {
  stop("No Census API key found. Run tidycensus::census_api_key('YOUR_KEY', install = TRUE) and restart R.")
}

# Brand colors for charts
brand <- list(
  forest   = "#0f3e17",
  petal    = "#79b88b",
  burgundy = "#7a1f3d",
  cream    = "#fffefc",
  charcoal = "#222222",
  mist     = "#efeeeb"
)

band_labels <- c(u18 = "Under 18", a18_64 = "Adults 18–64", s65 = "Seniors 65+")
band_colors <- c("Adults 18–64" = brand$petal, "Seniors 65+" = brand$forest)
measure_labels <- c(
  any       = "Any disability",
  selfcare  = "Self-care difficulty\n(bathing, dressing)",
  indliving = "Independent-living difficulty\n(errands, appointments)"
)

theme_marquez <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text               = element_text(color = brand$charcoal),
      plot.title         = element_text(color = brand$forest, size = base_size + 3),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = brand$charcoal),
      axis.text          = element_text(color = brand$charcoal),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = brand$mist),
      legend.position    = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = brand$cream, color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = brand$cream, color = NA)
    )
}
```

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
acs_vars <- load_variables(acs_year, "acs5", cache = TRUE) |>
  select(name, label) |>
  mutate(label = str_remove_all(label, ":"))

acs_pull <- function(level = c("county", "zcta"), table = NULL, variables = NULL) {
  level <- match.arg(level)
  args <- list(year = acs_year, survey = "acs5")
  if (!is.null(table))     args$table <- table
  if (!is.null(variables)) args$variables <- variables
  args <- if (level == "county") {
    c(args, geography = "county", state = "CA", county = "San Diego")
  } else {
    c(args, list(geography = "zcta", zcta = service_zips))
  }
  out <- do.call(get_acs, args)
  if (!is.null(table)) out <- left_join(out, acs_vars, by = c("variable" = "name"))
  out
}

last_part <- function(label) word(label, -1, sep = "!!")

age_band <- function(age) {
  case_when(
    age %in% c("Under 18 years", "5 to 17 years")                          ~ "u18",
    age %in% c("18 to 34 years", "35 to 64 years", "18 to 64 years")       ~ "a18_64",
    age %in% c("65 to 74 years", "75 years and over", "65 years and over") ~ "s65",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Population by age (B01001)
age_counts <- function(level) {
  acs_pull(level, table = "B01001") |>
    filter(str_count(label, "!!") == 3) |>
    mutate(
      age_txt = last_part(label),
      age_lo  = if_else(str_detect(age_txt, "^Under"), 0,
                        as.numeric(str_extract(age_txt, "\\d+")))
    ) |>
    group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
    summarise(
      pop_total = sum(estimate),
      pop_18_64 = sum(estimate[age_lo >= 18 & age_lo < 65]),
      pop_65    = sum(estimate[age_lo >= 65]),
      pop_75    = sum(estimate[age_lo >= 75]),
      pop_85    = sum(estimate[age_lo >= 85]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Disability / difficulty status by age band (C18108, B18106, B18107), parsed by label
status_by_age <- function(level, table, leaf_pattern, without_pattern) {
  acs_pull(level, table = table) |>
    filter(str_detect(last_part(label), leaf_pattern)) |>
    mutate(
      age  = str_extract(label, "Under 18 years|\\d+ to \\d+ years|\\d+ years and over"),
      band = age_band(age),
      has  = !str_detect(last_part(label), without_pattern)
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(band)) |>
    group_by(GEOID, band) |>
    summarise(
      with     = sum(estimate[has]),
      with_moe = moe_sum(moe[has], estimate[has]),
      universe = sum(estimate),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(pct = with / universe)
}

status_long <- function(level) {
  bind_rows(
    any       = status_by_age(level, "C18108", "disability", "^No disability"),
    selfcare  = status_by_age(level, "B18106", "difficulty", "^No "),
    indliving = status_by_age(level, "B18107", "difficulty", "^No "),
    .id = "measure"
  )
}

status_wide <- function(long) {
  long |>
    select(GEOID, measure, band, with, pct) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = c(measure, band), values_from = c(with, pct),
                names_glue = "{measure}_{band}_{.value}")
}

# Seniors living alone (B09020)
living_alone <- function(level) {
  acs_pull(level, table = "B09020") |>
    group_by(GEOID) |>
    summarise(
      pop65_universe = estimate[variable == "B09020_001"],
      alone_65       = sum(estimate[str_detect(label, regex("living alone$", ignore_case = TRUE))]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(pct_alone_65 = alone_65 / pop65_universe)
}

# Spanish spoken at home among people 65+ (B16004)
spanish_65 <- function(level) {
  acs_pull(level, table = "B16004") |>
    group_by(GEOID) |>
    summarise(
      pop65_lang = sum(estimate[str_detect(label, "!!65 years and over$")]),
      spanish_65 = sum(estimate[str_detect(label, "65 years and over!!Speak Spanish$")]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(pct_spanish_65 = spanish_65 / pop65_lang)
}

build_profile <- function(level) {
  long <- status_long(level)
  wide <- list(age_counts(level), status_wide(long), living_alone(level), spanish_65(level)) |>
    reduce(left_join, by = "GEOID")
  list(wide = wide, long = long)
}
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
county_raw <- build_profile("county")
zip_raw    <- build_profile("zcta")

county      <- county_raw$wide
county_long <- county_raw$long
zips        <- zip_raw$wide |> left_join(service_area, by = c("GEOID" = "zcta"))
zip_long    <- zip_raw$long |> left_join(service_area, by = c("GEOID" = "zcta"))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
county_long |>
  filter(band %in% c("a18_64", "s65")) |>
  mutate(measure = factor(measure_labels[measure], levels = rev(measure_labels)),
         band    = band_labels[band]) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pct, y = measure, fill = band)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(pct, 0.1)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.4,
            color = brand$charcoal) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = band_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "The need for help grows with age, but it isn't only about age") +
  theme_marquez()
```

Seniors are several times more likely than younger adults to need help with daily tasks. But
because there are so many more adults under 65, **younger adults with a disability are a
large share of the people who need a hand at home**. Home care isn't only for grandparents.

> Often the hardest part of needing help is the everyday: getting to the doctor, a hot meal,
> a ride to the store. Those are the moments we're here for.

## Neighborhood by neighborhood

Here's the same picture for the South Bay and East County communities closest to us, ranked
by how many adults have difficulty running errands or getting to appointments on their own.

  mutate(need_adults = indliving_a18_64_with + indliving_s65_with) |>
  arrange(desc(need_adults))

zip_rank |>

    ZIP = GEOID,

    `Seniors 65+` = comma(pop_65),

## What this means for families

::: {.panel-keylime}
**Many families in our area are caring for someone right now**, often while working full time.
A few things stood out to us:

- **Help with everyday tasks is the most common need.** More people have trouble with errands
  and appointments than with bathing or dressing. Companionship, rides and meals matter.
- **Younger adults need support too.** Developmental disabilities and injuries from accidents
  affect people at every age. The San Diego Regional Center alone serves about 41,350 people
  with developmental disabilities across San Diego and Imperial counties.
- **Language matters.** In several South Bay neighborhoods, a large share of seniors speak
  Spanish at home. A caregiver who speaks your loved one's language makes care feel like home.
:::

## About the data

- **Source:** U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2020–2024
  5-year estimates (tables B01001, B18106, B18107, C18108, B09020, B16004), pulled with the
  `tidycensus` R package. Regional Center figure: San Diego Regional Center FY 2023–24
  Performance Report, CA Department of Developmental Services.
- **People living in nursing homes aren't included**, which suits our purpose: these are
  people living in their own homes.
- **Neighborhood numbers are estimates** with real margins of error, especially in smaller
  ZIP codes. Treat the ranking as a general picture, not an exact count.
- **The measures overlap.** Someone with difficulty bathing often also has difficulty with
  errands, so the rows shouldn't be added together.
- **ZIP areas are approximate.** The Census uses "ZIP code tabulation areas," which closely
  match, but don't exactly equal, postal ZIP codes.
